title: 第九章过目不忘的效果第十章意外收获
content_zh:
;;
过了许久。
随着江宁翻看到最后一页，这本五禽拳拳谱被他彻底翻看完毕。
【此次翻阅拳谱，识文断字经验值共计增加10点。】
看到这道提示，江宁心中微感诧异，如此短暂的翻阅却是收获了十点经验值，如此效率大大出乎了他的意料。
旋即，他暂且将此事抛在脑后，微闭双目。
脑海中瞬间一页页浮现刚刚所看的五禽拳拳谱上面所记载的一切。
此刻他对于五禽拳也有了一个大体的认知。
这是一本入了品级的下乘武学，观摩自然界中虎，熊，猿，鹿，鹤五种动物所开创的一门拳法。
虎形大成爆发力极强，熊形大成力道大增，猿形大成身形灵敏，腾挪如意，鹤形大成速度极快，身体轻易，提气一点便可横跨丈许之远。
至于鹿形大成，则是矫健轻灵，一跃便可跨越高墙，并且有壮大精气神，调理身体状态的一种拳式。
如此刻在一旁的李姓女子。
拳谱上既有呼吸法的记载，也有练法的记载。
长期习练五禽拳，有壮大体内气血的功效，气血壮大至贯通周身，充斥全身四肢百骸，这是武道入品前的基础。
以此拳谱若是五禽同修，铸造出来的武道根基极为扎实，殊为难得，是一本极为合适做来武道奠基的功法。
除去适合奠基外，虎形为爆发，猿形为身法，即使对敌，也丝毫不差。
彻底了解五禽拳后，江宁对于这门拳法的认可度更高了。
对于他如今来说，这确实是一门极为适合他的拳法。
同时他也暗暗感慨，之前那两个多月的翻看家中书籍太重要了。
若非看过如此多的书籍，脑海中已经记载了很多关于这个世界的知识，他怎能做到看懂拳谱？

对于普通人来说，即使看的懂文字，给他一本拳谱也完全学不会，看不懂，若是冒然去练，必然会练偏，最终极易损伤身体。
这也是学武为何需要有人引领，亲自传授的缘故。
一本拳谱，那是无数感悟的升华，含有先人的智慧结晶。
【名称】：江宁
【源能】：3.6
【技艺】：
识文断字（一次破限572000）（特效：过目不忘）
五禽拳（未入门010）
看着面板，五禽拳出现在他的面板上，瞬间让他之前微微悬着的心落了下来。
面板上的识文断字这门技艺也因为他认真翻看五禽拳拳谱，短时间内涨了整整10点经验值。
旋即，江宁睁开双目，手中的那本拳谱则已经被他早已合拢。
“师姐，我看完了！”
“你记住了？”
“嗯！”江宁点点头。
“全记住了？？!”女子瞬间微睁，满脸不信的看着江宁。
“全都记住了！”江宁肯定道：“若是师姐不信，可以考考我！”
“好！”女子点点头，十分认同江宁这個提议。
随后，她问到：“第八页记载的是什么？”
听到这个提问，江宁毫不犹豫的开口：“猛虎下山，神发与目爪生威，强筋壮骨......”
听到江宁的回答，女子双目更是瞪大，随即她又问到：“第十页第三行呢？”

“展翅凌云之势，方可融形神一体，发乎于......”江宁直接开口。
女子双目渐渐瞪成浑圆的看着江宁。
过了半晌，江宁开口：“师姐还有什么要问的吗？”

After a long time.
As Jiang Ning turned to the last page, he had thoroughly read through the book of Five-Animal Fist.
[After reading the boxing manual this time, the experience value of reading and hyphenating will be increased by 10 points in total. 】
Seeing this prompt, Jiang Ning was slightly surprised. He gained ten experience points from browsing in such a short time. Such efficiency was beyond his expectation.
Immediately, he put the matter behind him for the time being and closed his eyes slightly.
Everything recorded in the Wu Qin Quan manual that I just read flashed through my mind page by page.
At this moment, he also had a general understanding of Wuqinquan.
This is a high-level martial arts book, a boxing technique created by observing the five animals in nature: tiger, bear, ape, deer, and crane.
The tiger-shaped Dacheng has extremely strong explosive power, the bear-shaped Dacheng has greatly increased strength, the ape-shaped Dacheng has a nimble body and can move freely, and the crane-shaped Dacheng is extremely fast and easy, and can span a distance of ten feet with just a little lift of energy.
As for the deer-shaped Dacheng, it is a boxing style that is strong and agile, can cross high walls in one leap, strengthens the spirit, and regulates the physical condition.
Such as the woman surnamed Li who is standing by at this moment.
There are records of breathing techniques as well as practice techniques in the boxing manual.
Long-term practice of Wuqinquan has the effect of strengthening the qi and blood in the body. The qi and blood can be strengthened to penetrate the whole body and fill the body, limbs and bones. This is the foundation of martial arts before entering the level.
If this boxing manual is practiced by Wu Qin, it will create a very solid foundation for martial arts, which is extremely rare. It is a very suitable book for laying the foundation for martial arts.
In addition to being suitable for laying foundations, the tiger shape is used for explosions, and the ape shape is used for body skills. Even against the enemy, it is not bad at all.
After thoroughly understanding Wuqinquan, Jiang Ning's recognition of this boxing method is even higher.
For him now, this is indeed a boxing technique that is very suitable for him.
At the same time, he also secretly lamented that the previous two months of looking through the books at home were so important.
If he hadn't read so many books and had a lot of knowledge about the world recorded in his mind, how could he understand the boxing manual?
For ordinary people, even if they can understand the text, they will not be able to learn it at all if they are given a boxing manual. If they do not understand it, if they practice rashly, they will inevitably practice incorrectly, and in the end it will be extremely easy to damage the body.
This is why learning martial arts requires someone to guide and teach it personally.
A boxing manual is the sublimation of countless insights and contains the crystallization of the wisdom of our ancestors.
[Name]: Jiangning
[Source Energy]: 3.6
[Technique]:
Reading and hyphenation (breaking the limit of 572,000 at one time) (Special effect: photographic memory)
Five-animal boxing (not yet started 010)
Looking at the panel, Wuqinquan appeared on his panel, which instantly made his heart drop.
The skill of reading and hyphenation on the panel also increased by a full 10 experience points in a short period of time because he carefully read through the Wu Qin Quan manual.
Immediately, Jiang Ning opened his eyes, and the boxing book in his hand had already been closed by him.
"Sister, I've finished reading!"
"You remember?"
"Yeah!" Jiang Ning nodded.
"Remember everything??!" The woman opened her eyes slightly and looked at Jiang Ning with disbelief.
"I remember everything!" Jiang Ning affirmed: "If senior sister doesn't believe it, you can give me a test!"
"Okay!" The woman nodded, fully agreeing with Jiang Ning's proposal.
Then, she asked: "What is recorded on page eight?"
Hearing this question, Jiang Ning said without hesitation: "The tiger came down the mountain, its hair and eyes and claws were powerful, its muscles and bones were strong..."
Hearing Jiang Ning's answer, the woman's eyes widened even more, and then she asked again: "Where's the third line on page ten?"
"Only when you spread your wings to soar into the clouds can you merge body and spirit into one body, which comes from..." Jiang Ning said directly.
The woman's eyes gradually widened and looked at Jiang Ning.
After a while, Jiang Ning said, "Senior sister, do you have anything else to ask?"
